## Areas of Practice
1. Tax Residence & Domicile Planning (non-doms, expatriates, UK departure)
2. HMRC Disputes, Enquiries & Investigations (CoP 9, tax residency disputes, offshore disclosure)
3. Corporate Tax Restructuring, Mergers & Acquisitions, Management Buy-Outs
4. Transfer Pricing & Intellectual Property Rights Structuring
5. Employee Share Incentives: EMI, CSOP, SIP, Unapproved Options, EOTs, EBTs
6. Offshore Structuring: trusts, foundations, international holding companies
7. Capital Gains Tax Planning (entrepreneurs' relief, holdover, rollover, offshore gains)
8. Inheritance Tax Planning (BPR, APR, trusts, UK departure planning)
9. IR35 & Off-Payroll Working Rules
10. Double Taxation Treaties & International Tax Planning

## Notable Commentary & Cases
- **Kevin McCabe v HMRC** [2024] UKUT 280 (TCC) – tax residence dispute commentary
- **Finance Act 2025, s.44(3)** – critique of extended deemed domicile period (3 → 10 years)
- UK departure planning following IHT regime changes

## Chambers Information
Burnell Chambers is an independent barristers' chambers located at 1A Middle Temple Lane, London EC4Y 9AA, with an additional Dublin office. Practice areas include Tax Law, Commercial & Chancery, International & Offshore, Public Law, Defamation & Privacy, Intellectual Property, Investigations, Disciplinary & Regulatory, and Alternative Dispute Resolution. Chambers Director: Steven Newbery.
